method.method_draft: Use mass points. From the diagram/text, identify that D lies on BC, E lies on AC, and cevians AD and BE meet at T. Assign masses m_A, m_B, m_C to A, B, C. Since T divides AD with AT/DT=3, mass points gives (m_B+m_C)/m_A=3 because the mass at D is m_B+m_C. Since T divides BE with BT/ET=4, it gives (m_A+m_C)/m_B=4 because the mass at E is m_A+m_C. Solve these two equations: m_B+m_C=3m_A and m_A+m_C=4m_B, yielding m_B:m_C=4:11. Since D balances masses on BC, CD/BD=m_B/m_C, so CD/BD=4/11.

图像描述：图中是三角形 ABC，D 位于边 BC 上，E 位于边 AC 上，线段 AD 与 BE 在三角形内部交于 T。这与题目给出的 D 在 BC、E 在 AC，且 AD 与 BE 相交于 T 一致。

按照指定方法使用质量点。设顶点 A, B, C 的质量分别为 m_A, m_B, m_C。因为 D 在 BC 上，所以 D 点的合质量为 m_B + m_C；因为 E 在 AC 上，所以 E 点的合质量为 m_A + m_C。

T 在 AD 上且 AT/DT = 3。质量点中，线段上的距离比等于端点质量的反比，因此 AT/DT = m_D/m_A = (m_B + m_C)/m_A = 3，所以 m_B + m_C = 3m_A。

T 在 BE 上且 BT/ET = 4，因此 BT/ET = m_E/m_B = (m_A + m_C)/m_B = 4，所以 m_A + m_C = 4m_B。

解方程组：由 m_B + m_C = 3m_A 得 m_C = 3m_A - m_B。代入 m_A + m_C = 4m_B，得到 m_A + 3m_A - m_B = 4m_B，即 4m_A = 5m_B，所以 m_B = 4m_A/5。于是 m_C = 3m_A - 4m_A/5 = 11m_A/5，因此 m_B:m_C = 4:11。

D 在 BC 上平衡 B 与 C 的质量，所以 CD/BD = m_B/m_C = 4/11。
